primitives.note: Decisive Strike arms Garen's next basic attack (within a 4.5s window) with bonus physical damage, a lunge, and a silence
Decisive Strike resets Garen's basic attack timer on cast
Judgment deals physical damage in periodic ticks (spins) to nearby enemies over its active duration
Judgment is a channelled spin that locks Garen out of basic attacks while active; it can be recast after 1s to end early or auto-ends after its ticks complete
Judgment's spin (tick) count increases with bonus attack speed from items/level growth (1 extra spin per 25% bonus AS), directly determining total dot damage
Judgment builds a hit-counter on the enemy champion target that triggers a 25% armor-reduction debuff on the 6th hit, refreshing every 6th hit thereafter
Judgment's per-spin damage can critically strike, but only for a reduced (30% of normal crit bonus) amount rather than full crit damage
Judgment deals 25% increased damage to the 'nearest' enemy hit; with a single stationary dummy target this bonus is always satisfied
Demacian Justice deals a burst of true damage on a fixed 0.435s cast time, on a long cooldown
Demacian Justice's true damage scales with a percentage of the target's current missing health, so its value depends on prior damage dealt

needsBespoke.why: All damage-relevant mechanics (Q's empowered-attack-plus-reset, E's AS-scaling channelled dot with a target hit-counter and crit-capable ticks, R's flat-plus-missing-health true damage) map onto existing primitives; no unique logic beyond combining them is required. W and P are purely defensive/self-sustain and never read by a damage-only fight.

unsettled.question: Does Decisive Strike's bonus damage scale with 50% AD (as stated in the wiki leveling line) or 150% AD (as the bin's tADRatio=1.5 computes)?
options: 50% bonus AD per the wiki's displayed tooltip value
150% bonus AD per the bin's tADRatio constant, treating the wiki tooltip as stale/wrong

unsettled.question: How long is the basic-attack lockout that Decisive Strike imposes on Garen, and how exactly does attack speed shorten it? Neither source gives a base duration value.
options: Lockout is simply the normal attack windup/timer with no separate penalty
There is a distinct, undocumented base lockout value that is reduced by bonus attack speed
quotes: ''Decisive Strike'' locks '''Garen''' out of using basic attacks for a short period of time.<!--The enhanced attack or the ability itself?--> This is shortened with {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}}.

unsettled.question: Is Judgment's 'nearest enemy' 25% bonus damage a single damage instance (base tick already multiplied by 1.25) or two separate simultaneous damage instances (a base tick plus a distinct bonus tick)?
options: Single instance: each spin against the (only) target deals TotalDamage*1.25 as one hit
Two instances: each spin deals a base-tick hit and a separate 'increased damage' hit
quotes: ''Judgment'' deals {{ap|({{#var:near}}-1)*100}}% increased damage against the nearest enemy hit.

unsettled.question: Does Judgment's 6-hit counter (for triggering the 25% armor-reduction debuff) persist cumulatively across separate casts of Judgment regardless of gaps, or does it reset if the prior armor-reduction debuff instance expires (6s) before 6 more hits land?
options: Counter is a persistent lifetime/fight hit-tally on the target, independent of the debuff's own 6s timer
Counter resets to 0 whenever the active debuff instance expires before reaching the next 6-hit threshold
quotes: Enemy champions hit 6 times by ''Judgment'' are inflicted with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|25% armor reduction}}}} for 6 seconds, with the duration refreshing upon the 7th hit and every 6th hit thereafter.

proposal: Open by casting Judgment (E) to start the continuous spin, generating dot damage ticks and building toward the 6-hit armor-shred debuff on the dummy.

Weave in Decisive Strike (Q) on its 8s cooldown as soon as it is available; its cast does not require a target and grants the empowered next-attack (bonus physical damage, silence) plus an attack-timer reset, so use it to refresh/queue an auto-attack whenever Garen is not locked out by E's spin.
Auto-attack whenever not locked out by Judgment's channel, prioritizing landing Q's empowered attack as soon as the window opens after each Q cast.

Let each Judgment fully run its spins (do not manually recast/cancel early) to maximize tick count and hit-counter progress toward the armor-shred, then recast Judgment again as soon as its post-effect cooldown allows.

Cast Demacian Justice (R) once it is off cooldown; because R's true damage scales with the target's missing health percentage and its cooldown (80-120s) allows only a single cast within the 15s window, time it after some sustained Q/E/auto-attack damage has already lowered the dummy's health, to maximize the missing-health term.
Ignore Courage (W) and Perseverance (P) entirely, since neither deals damage or debuffs the target.
questions: Can Decisive Strike be cast while Judgment's spin-lockout is active (to queue the empowered attack for right after the spin ends), or does casting Q during E's channel get blocked/delayed?

Given R's cooldown exceeds the 15s fight window, is there any scenario where casting R immediately (for guaranteed inclusion) beats delaying it for a larger missing-health percentage, e.g. if the dummy's health/resist profile makes early flat damage more valuable than the later missing-health scaling?

During Judgment's channel, is Garen able to walk into attack range/reposition for a real fight, and does that matter for a stationary dummy with no range constraints (i.e., is there ever a reason to delay E to stay in auto-attack range)?
Does landing Decisive Strike's empowered attack during Judgment's active channel interrupt or delay the ongoing spin ticks?
